meta.scope: PvE enemy presets for the Dragonheir: Silent Gods battle simulator; player on a new server in the Season 1 beginner season (Reborn version), account level ~59.

confidenceScale.verified: official source (dragonheir.info official wiki/articles incl. in-game screenshots) or two independent sources
confidenceScale.estimated: derived by us; the derivation is explained next to the value

meta.versionWarning: Dragonheir relaunched as the 'Reborn' version in mid-2025. Articles dated 2023-10..2024-08 describe the LEGACY game (graves had difficulty 1-9). Reborn graves go to difficulty 15/20 and boss kits changed. Every value carries 'version': 'reborn' or 'legacy'. Prefer reborn values; legacy values are only fallbacks.
meta.biggestGap: No source anywhere (official, HellHades, Reddit, CN/JP/KR, YouTube titles) publishes boss HP, ATK or DEF numbers for any PvE mode. Those fields are null everywhere. What IS published: boss level, recommended Accuracy/Resistance, enemy Resistance per difficulty (legacy), skill names, skill cast timelines, exact % numbers for Continental Challenge bosses, and mechanic descriptions. HP/ATK/DEF must be calibrated from the user's own battle results (see calibrationPlan).
meta.articleApi: Official article bodies can be fetched as JSON: https://apih5.dmzgame.com/api/wz/getwz_id.php?id=<articleId> (fields: title, time, wztext HTML). Many details are inside images in wztext.

accuracyVsResistance.rule: Debuff/control/shield-dispel/buff-dispel success depends on (attacker Accuracy - target Resistance). First the skill's own chance is rolled, then Accuracy vs Resistance. Dispelling from your own allies ignores Accuracy/Resistance.
accuracyVsResistance.simHint: estimated: piecewise-linear interpolation of curve_avgSuccessByDiff is a reasonable model; samples are 25-trial tests so +-10% noise.

source.note: How Hero Attributes & Conditions Work; tables are images dated 2023-10-31

energyAndHaste.formula: recharge_time = base_energy_cost / (1 * (1 + SkillHaste/500)); e.g. 20s skill with 100 Skill Haste -> 16.67s
energyAndHaste.enlightenment: Derivative Damage bonus = Enlightenment/200 (40 Enl = +20%); Derivative Damage cannot crit

enemyAI.rule: In non-PvP battles enemies use their ultimate skill immediately when it finishes recharging. Board is usually 5x8; allies start left, enemies right.

items: Bosses are immune to Execution effects (e.g. execute-below-15%-HP skills); some skills deal a bonus instead (one hero skill: +600% Attack Derivative vs bosses).
Max-HP-reduction effects from gear (e.g. 'Life Clipping') cannot trigger on bosses; some hero Max-HP reductions are 'invalid for Bosses'.
Almost all dungeon/CC bosses carry 'Control Immunity: Immune to control effects.'

mechanics.name: Shadow Poison (passive)
mechanics.effect: On boss single-target attack, chance to increase Wisp damage and command Wisps to assist; chance decreases as debuffs on Wisps increase. A Wisp dying deals damage (True Damage per 584) to the boss.

mechanics.name: Poisonous Fletching
mechanics.effect: AOE damage, dispels 1 buff, summons up to 2 new Wisps.

mechanics.name: Harpy's Wrath
mechanics.effect: Global damage to all player heroes and grants a shield to all boss-side units (shield-dispel heroes speed up runs from difficulty 9).

mechanics.name: Harpy's Breath
mechanics.effect: Series of high-damage single-target hits (tank killer). Mitigate with Attack Penalty / Damage Reduction before it lands.

mechanics.name: Skill cadence
mechanics.effect: Boss intel timeline shows skill casts at 6s, 12s, 18s (3-skill rotation, ~6s apart, 18s cycle).

mechanics.name: Challenge Mode affixes (S2+ only, rotating)
mechanics.effect: Harpy's Breath inflicts 50% Defense Penalty for 20s; defeated Wisp spreads its debuffs to enemies, each debuff spreads 4 times; while boss has a shield Wisps take 75% less damage; Wisps +40% Attack and +40% Defense; Poisonous Fletching +50% damage.

source.note: Traveler's Tactics Challenge Mode Vol.2 infographic

mechanics.name: Legacy S3 boss table
mechanics.effect: If a target has fewer than 2 debuffs, the boss hits random enemies 3 times with high single-target damage; 4 wisps assist the boss.

grave_of_venom.whatKillsTeams: Harpy's Breath burst on the tank (multi-hit), especially with Wisps assisting; AoE on grouped formations.
counters: Frost/Poison AoE to debuff and kill Wisps

stages.note: HellHades main account speed-farm (endgame account, glass-cannon team)

mechanics.name: Blood Gush (passive)
mechanics.effect: When the boss deals HP damage it steals HP and reduces the target's Max HP. Shields block it.

mechanics.name: Rage of Blood
mechanics.effect: Boss gains a damage-boosting buff (dispel / Buff Prohibition).

mechanics.name: Vampiric Shield
mechanics.effect: High single-target damage; damage dealt is converted into a shield on the boss.

mechanics.name: Punishment of Blood
mechanics.effect: Dispels 1 buff from every player hero and attacks them; much higher damage to targets without buffs. The extra damage vs unbuffed targets applies at difficulty 9+.

mechanics.name: Skill cadence (legacy)
mechanics.effect: The boss finishes its three skills in 18 seconds.

mechanics.name: Challenge Mode (S2+)
mechanics.effect: Faster recharge, stronger buffs; damage escalates each rotation.

mechanics.name: Legacy S3 boss table
mechanics.effect: While buffed the boss ignores Immortality/Invincibility; removes shields before dealing damage.

grave_of_curse.whatKillsTeams: Snowballing Max-HP loss in long fights; unbuffed heroes hit by Punishment of Blood at diff 9+; undispelled Rage of Blood.
counters: Buff dispel/prohibition right after Rage of Blood

source.note: battle screenshot 'Lv.300 Colossal Scavenger' vs Lv.100 heroes

stages.special: From difficulty 15 the boss is under an undispellable Attack Penalty (official wording).

mechanics.name: Source of Filth (passive)
mechanics.effect: Basic attacks have a chance to inflict Poison. Boss is always under Attack Penalty. Each debuff gives the boss Corruption stacks (more debuffs -> stronger skills).

mechanics.name: Putrid Breath
mechanics.effect: Global attack; inflicts Poison and Recharge Speed Penalty; Poison stacks scale with Corruption.

mechanics.name: Rotting Assault
mechanics.effect: Puts 2 of the boss's debuffs on a random target and deals AOE damage centered on it; target count grows with Corruption.

mechanics.name: Greedy Hunt
mechanics.effect: Devours current target: damage over time and boss heals based on damage dealt (more Poison stacks on target -> more healing). Ends after the boss takes a certain amount of damage. Invisibility (Thia) makes it lose the target.

mechanics.name: Legacy S3 boss table
mechanics.effect: Reduces Max HP; deals more damage per debuff on the target; inflicts Healing Prohibition.

grave_of_rot.whatKillsTeams: Stacked Poison + Greedy Hunt healing the boss; boss has high HP and restoration so low DPS teams time out.

difficultyBands.1-6: lower pressure; kill summoned minions fast

mechanics.name: Scorch
mechanics.effect: Single-target attack that splashes to all targets with Burn.

mechanics.name: Nirvana
mechanics.effect: Boss becomes Invisible when phoenix eggs are reborn; the eggs' skill heals the boss and grants it a Total Damage Bonus. Minions heal the boss over time while alive.

mechanics.name: Fire of Dead Phoenix
mechanics.effect: High damage to all player heroes + Burn on all.

mechanics.name: Nestling damage reduction
mechanics.effect: Boss takes reduced damage while Phoenix Nestlings are alive (stated for Challenge Mode guide).

mechanics.name: Legacy S3 boss table
mechanics.effect: 2 eggs; if all nestlings are alive when the boss tries to resurrect them, the boss gains damage reduction.

heretical_ruins.whatKillsTeams: Fire of Dead Phoenix burst on the whole team (needs Immortality/Resurrection/Invincibility or stacked DR); Burn splash via Scorch; eggs healing/buffing the boss.

mechanics.name: Shield Warrior (passive)
mechanics.effect: Two forms. Shield Form: basic attacks deal Global Damage. Sword Form: basic attacks deal heavy single-target damage.

mechanics.name: Berserker's Wrath - Shield Form
mechanics.effect: Stuns the hero farthest from the boss. If the Stun fails or is dispelled the boss enters Backfire (deals less damage, takes more damage).

mechanics.name: Devouring Shadows - Shield Form
mechanics.effect: Switches to Sword Form and gains Attack Up.

mechanics.name: Berserker's Wrath - Sword Form
mechanics.effect: High damage to the single hero with the highest Attack.

mechanics.name: Devouring Shadows - Sword Form
mechanics.effect: Attacks all, dispels ALL their buffs, gains a permanent (undispellable) Total Damage Bonus per buff dispelled, switches back to Shield Form with Defense Up.

mechanics.name: Legacy S2 variant
mechanics.effect: Passive partly resists Ultimate Energy Reduction; boss stacks Damage Reduction as its HP drops.

mechanics.name: Legacy S3 boss table
mechanics.effect: Converts 80% of basic-attack damage into a shield; receives only half of Ultimate (energy) Down effects; gains a stackable damage mitigation for every 35% HP missing.

stageBands.1-6: goblins have low attack power and HP

rules.rule: Rewards scale with clear speed (stars by time left); run 1 tank + 4 DPS or 5 DPS; AoE DPS recommended.
After Resonance Lv.100 the dungeon only drops Gold.
6 waves; official tip: clear wave 1 with 2 heroes' ultimates, wave 2 with the other 3, repeat.
Cannot push past Stage 6 in the first five days of a new account/server.
Next stage unlocks after claiming the 3rd-tier (3-star) reward of the previous stage.

fey_meander.structure: Floor/stage ladder. Reborn: 300 floors (community guide 1162). Most stages are enemy HERO teams (5 heroes) that cast ultimates continuously; periodic boss stages. Daily rewards by stages cleared; clearing thresholds unlock the Labyrinth of Curiosities.

stages.mechanics: Boss continuously applies Poison and gains a damage buff after successfully poisoning; its 2nd active skill stuns (stack Resistance on key supports).

stages.boss: Lady of Greeneries (gains Attack Bonus stacks via Poison; e.g. 70 stacks)

mechanics.name: Enemy hero teams
mechanics.effect: Regular stages = enemy hero lineups; pressure comes from enemies chaining ultimates; control teams (Holy Hunter stun set) or Frost AoE recommended.

mechanics.name: Accuracy gate
mechanics.effect: Each floor has a required Accuracy for debuff/control heroes (community guide: 'must have required accuracy for the floor').

continental_challenge.event: Imperial Shadow Recast (S1 beginner-season Continental Challenge)

rules.rule: 3 rounds, each 1 week; 6 bosses with different stage traits; each boss once per round; each hero once per round.
Attempts: 2 in round 1, +2 per round, max 6 in round 3.
Starts at server day 22 on new servers.
Rating per boss battle by damage: S >= 22,000,000; A+ >= 11,000,000; A >= 7,000,000; B >= 3,500,000; C >= 200,000. Weekly ranking by total damage.
Fight length: legacy Continental Challenges were 5-minute (300 s) fights; Reborn guides only say 'within the time limit'.
rules.note: not confirmed for Imperial Shadow Recast; treat 300 s as default

damageFalloff.text: After taking 200,000,000 cumulative damage in a single battle, subsequent damage taken is reduced by 90%.

totalDamageBonus.text: Gains 1 stack of Damage Bonus after casting an ultimate skill. Each stack increases damage dealt by 200%. Cannot be blocked or dispelled. Lasts indefinitely.

bossCommon.note: Both intel screens show identical traits; assumed to apply to all 6 bosses (estimated for Thelendor/Twitch/Vinyara/Tamar).

stageTraits: Heroes' summoned unit with the highest Attack deals 240% more damage.
Heroes' allies receive 50% increased healing and shield effects.

mechanics.name: Lunar Arrival
mechanics.effect: Strikes enemies within 2 tiles; keep back row >2 tiles away; boss deals high overall damage; boss skills attack random targets.

damageReference.note: endgame relaunch-server account; >200M is inside the 90% damage falloff

stageTraits: Each time an ally's ultimate skill hits an enemy, the next cast of their ultimate deals 10% more damage.
When the boss is affected by Healing Reduction or Healing Reversal, it deals 30% less damage.

skills.name: Restless Soul
skills.effect: Summons 2 Spirits for 6s and grants 40% Attack Up and Attack Speed Up II to the boss and the Spirits for 6s.

skills.name: Death Reaping
skills.effect: Necrotic Damage to all enemies and summons 1 Spirit near each target hit for 24s; up to 5 Spirits per cast.

mechanics.name: Summons count for score
mechanics.effect: Damage to the boss's summons counts toward total damage; boss buffs itself and its summons (bring buff dispel/prohibition).

stageTraits: Stage buff favours AoE schools (Corrosion, Rally, Thunderbolt).
Successfully resisting or dispelling debuffs triggers a stacking Damage Bonus from the Stage Buff.

mechanics.name: Toxin
mechanics.effect: Inflicts Toxin on multiple targets; his damage increases with the number of Toxin stacks. Counter: debuff dispel/immunity or high Resistance.

stageTraits: Favours Ice Blast school (stage buff + affinity).

mechanics.name: Skill interval
mechanics.effect: Boss casts skills on a 9-second interval.

mechanics.name: Shield -> Invincibility
mechanics.effect: If her Shield is not dispelled/broken quickly she enters an undispellable Invincibility. HellHades: gains a powerful shield plus increased Defense and Damage Reduction.

mechanics.name: Counter
mechanics.effect: Vinyara (hero) drains her Ultimate Energy; Mimic familiar applies advanced Recharging Speed Penalty.

stageTraits: Heroes' basic attacks deal extra non-crit Physical Damage equal to 100% Attack.
When an ally breaks a boss's shield, that ally gains +50% Attack for 10s.

skills.name: Holy Fire Smite
skills.effect: 3 Holy Fire attacks, each on a random enemy in range, 100% chance to dispel 1 buff; boss gains 20 stacks of layered shield for 10s.

skills.name: Lunar Retribution
skills.effect: Fire Damage to all enemies, 100% chance of Attack Speed Penalty II for 20s; boss gains 40 stacks of layered shield for 20s.

mechanics.name: Layered Shield
mechanics.effect: Each hit removes one layer (multi-hit counters it); damage that breaks layers does not count as damage.

stageTraits: Boss takes more damage the more Debuff stacks she has (Toxin/Burn recommended).

mechanics.name: Debuff/Control spam
mechanics.effect: Dispels buffs, frequently inflicts debuffs and control on multiple targets. ~180 Resistance makes heroes largely immune; a Stand United talent support needs >400 Resistance.

legacyReference.text: Legacy CC (Lunar Halo, 2024): bosses Lv.240 with 260 Resistance (280 Accuracy recommended, 220 found sufficient); bosses take 100% extra damage from their weak element; 2 universal traits: control immunity and a 200% universal damage buff after their ultimate, undispellable, until battle end.

continental_challenge.confidence: verified (rules, traits, 2 full skill kits); HP/ATK/DEF not found (bosses are score bosses; Damage Falloff caps useful damage near 200M)

grand_gladiator_arena.note: PvP: enemies are other players' 5-hero defense teams. No PvE preset; build enemy presets from real hero data. Legacy note: a fully defensive team can win by not being killed 'within the time limit'.

talent_dungeons_elemental_domains.note: Not in the user's list but on the same menu (Wildfire / Resplendence / Permafrost talent dungeons, legacy 'Flame/Tempest/Frost Domain').

bosses.searing_lord_flame: Counters Fire & Poison heroes (they deal less / take more). First two skills apply Burn; ultimate damage scales with all active Burn stacks.
bosses.lord_of_lightning_tempest: Counters Lightning & Radiance. Ultimate self-damages then spawns 5 hatchlings; surviving minions boost boss damage by 50%. Any healing gives BOTH sides stackable skill acceleration.
bosses.lady_of_frostthorn_frost: Counters Ice & Dark. Gains damage reduction each time she lands a debuff; 1st skill nerfs player-card attack; ultimate = AoE Stun for 5s.

power.summary: The game shows a per-hero 'Power' number (seen by the capture tool in the hero list), but NO official or community formula was found. Official dungeon screens do not use recommended Power; they show enemy Level, Recommended Accuracy and (for some bosses) Recommended Resistance.

levelRecommendations.text: Legacy graves difficulty 9: team level 90+ (heroes Lv.90 breakthrough), tank HP >70-80k, DEF >2.0-3.0k, debuffers >220 Accuracy, average hero HP >35k.
Continental Challenge screenshots show player heroes at Lv.100 vs Lv.240 bosses.
YouTube title (OddOneGaming, S8): 'Grave Of Venom 20 ... NO Mythic Gear Lvl 79 Team' - a level-79 team cleared Venom difficulty 20 in S8.

heroLevelGrowthData.text: Official heroLevelBase.json gives per-level growth multipliers for HP/ATK/DEF (1.14 at Lv1-30, 1.22-1.41 at 36-46, 1.72-2.15 at 51-66, 2.62-3.27 at 71-86, 5.58 at 91, 7.74-9.67 at 96-99). These are HERO numbers; whether monsters share this curve is unknown.

power.confidence: verified that no formula is published

calibrationPlan.why: Boss HP/ATK/DEF are not published anywhere; they must be measured.
steps: Boss HP: in Continental Challenge the score = damage dealt; for dungeons use the boss HP bar: record damage-dealt numbers from the battle stats screen on a kill (total damage to boss ~= boss HP + overheal/shields).
Boss ATK: record damage taken by a hero with known HP/DEF from one boss skill (battle statistics 'damage taken'), then solve the sim's damage formula for ATK*skill%.
Boss DEF: hit the boss with a known hero/skill once with and once without a Defense Penalty and compare.

Level scaling: data points available are Lv100 (grave diff 8-9, goblin diff 9), Lv110 (harpy intel), Lv145 (ruins diff 7), Lv160 (battlefield diff 7), Lv240 (CC), Lv300 (challenge mode / high rot). Fit stats-vs-level once 2-3 bosses are measured.
Legacy reference points (diff 9, Lv.170 bosses): total damage dealt 3.8M-5.9M per clear, see legacyBattleStatistics. Use only as a sanity check.

legacyBattleStatistics.what: End-of-battle Statistics screens published in official lineup guides (legacy 2024, difficulty 9, Lv.170 bosses). Damage dealt = all damage to all enemies (boss + adds + shields + boss self-healing), so it is an UPPER-BOUND proxy for total enemy effective HP, not boss HP. 'enemyDpsOnTeam' = gross damage taken / clear time.
legacyBattleStatistics.confidence: verified (numbers read from official screenshots); as an HP proxy: estimated
legacyBattleStatistics.usableFor: Order-of-magnitude sanity check of a simulator: legacy diff 9 (Lv.170 boss) needed ~3.8M-5.9M total team damage over 2:10-4:35; the team took ~1.0M-3.1M damage. Reborn S1 difficulties and levels differ, so do not use these as S1 values.
